name: Racecadotrile 10mg Powder 18 Granulated Sachets
description: Racecadotril, in 10 mg granules in 18 sachets, is used for the treatment of acute diarrhea in infants (over 3 months old) and young children. Its best-known brand name is Hidrasec, although it is also available as a generic. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
